conceptual assets.concept: Data stored in the FIFO (words written into internal storage and produced on read)
conceptual assets.reasoning: Writes store wdata_i into the block's storage and reads drive rdata_o: for fifo_depth>1 the write processes perform "if (we = '1') then fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(w_pnt(w_pnt'left-1 downto 0)))) <= wdata_i;" (reset and no-reset variants) and for fifo_depth=1 the processes perform "fifo_reg <= wdata_i;". Read paths assign rdata_o from storage (async: "rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt_ff(r_pnt_ff'left-1 downto 0))));", sync: "rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt(...))));", small: "rdata_o <= fifo_reg;"). The RTL shows the write and read flows and indexing; corrupting stored words or their selection changes readback, so integrity of the stored FIFO contents is established. Structural realizations map the input that sets written data and the registers/array that store and export it.

conceptual assets.concept: Write-enable decision that controls when write operations update FIFO storage and advance the write pointer
conceptual assets.reasoning: The entity computes an internal write decision 'we' from the input and status and uses it to perform writes: "we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free);" and write processes condition on "if (we = '1') then ..." to update fifo_mem/fifo_reg and w_pnt (via w_nxt). Incorrect setting of this decision would allow or prevent writes, violating the write/update flow implemented in the RTL. The input that supplies the request and the internal computed decision realize the concept.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable decision that controls when reads advance the read pointer and allow data to be consumed
conceptual assets.reasoning: The entity computes an internal read decision 're' from the input and availability and uses it to advance r_pnt via r_nxt and thereby to consume data: "re <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail);" and r_nxt is incremented when "re = '1'". The computed read decision gates pointer advancement and the read-side data flow; corruption of this decision would alter dequeuing behavior, establishing Integrity. The input request and the internal decision are the realizations.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO pointer state (write and read pointers) that select memory indices and determine occupancy/status
conceptual assets.reasoning: Pointer registers hold the FIFO indices used for indexing storage and computing status: pointer_reg process updates w_pnt and r_pnt on rising_edge(clk_i) or resets them when rstn_i='0' ("w_pnt <= w_nxt; r_pnt <= r_nxt"). Writes index fifo_mem by to_integer(unsigned(w_pnt(...))) and reads index by r_pnt or r_pnt_ff; full/empty/level are computed from comparisons of w_pnt and r_pnt. The RTL demonstrates these pointers are the authoritative stored indices; corrupting them changes addresses, status and read/write behavior, so their integrity is established.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO occupancy count (level) reported to level_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: For fifo_depth>1 the RTL computes occupancy as a numeric difference: "level <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt));" and a process copies that vector into the 32-bit output: level_extend assigns level_o(level'left downto 0) <= level(...). The occupancy value is therefore produced by the block and exported; corrupting this computed count would misreport occupancy to consumers, so integrity of the occupancy count is established.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO status flags and availability signals (full, empty, free, avail, half) and their exported status outputs
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL computes fullness/emptiness and derived availability and half-full indicators from the pointers: e.g. "match <= '1' when (...)"; "full <= '1' when (r_pnt(...) /= w_pnt(...)) and (match = '1') else '0'"; "empty <= '1' when (...)"; then "free <= not full; avail <= not empty; half <= level(level'left-1) or full;" These signals are used to gate we/re when FIFO_SAFE and are exported via free_o/avail_o/half_o (combinationally when FIFO_RSYNC=false or registered in sync_status when FIFO_RSYNC=true). Because flows depend on correct status for gating and reporting, integrity of these status signals is established. The internal computed flags and the status output ports realize the concept.

conceptual assets.concept: Clear command that resets pointers (FIFO clear/flush event)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL makes w_nxt and r_nxt zero when clear_i = '1' ("w_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ..." and similarly for r_nxt), and pointer_reg will load those zeros into w_pnt/r_pnt on the next clock edge. Assertion of clear_i therefore resets pointer state (clearing the FIFO view); incorrect or unauthorized assertion modifies FIFO occupancy and indexing, so integrity of the clear command is established. The input that the entity consumes realizes this concept.
